landing.heroTitle: Understand your health patterns before they become problems.
landing.heroDescription: Log a 60-second daily check-in, read your lab reports on your own device, and get grounded explanations from an assistant that is honest about what it cannot know.
landing.feature1Body: Patterns and your General Health Score are computed by versioned local logic — reproducible, never guessed by a model.
landing.feature2Body: Lab PDFs and photos are read with on-device OCR and stored in your browser. Only values you confirm are saved.
landing.feature3Body: The AI explains, summarises and plans. It never diagnoses, never prescribes and always shows which tools it used.
landing.feature4Body: Check-ins made without a connection queue locally and sync the moment you are back online.
landing.privacyCard: Your data belongs to you: every record is scoped to your account, documents never leave your device, and you can export or permanently delete everything from Settings.
landing.heroBadge: 100% Private • Preventive Health Intelligence • Works Offline
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Three simple steps to turn daily data into proactive wellness awareness.
landing.step1Desc: Log sleep, water, exercise, and vitals by voice or tap. Works smoothly even offline.
landing.step2Desc: Upload blood or lab reports for on-device biomarker insights, while our engine tracks your health score.
landing.step3Desc: Ask your AI companion questions, understand complex medical terms, and prepare for doctor visits.
landing.pillarSubtitle: Built for personal privacy, clinical safety, and effortless everyday use.
landing.pillar1Desc: Speak naturally in English, Tamil, or Hindi, or tap dials to record sleep, hydration, and vitals in under a minute.
landing.pillar2Desc: Drop lab PDFs or photos. On-device OCR extracts and explains biomarkers without uploading documents to the cloud.
landing.pillar3Desc: Local deterministic algorithms calculate your Health Score and detect subtle shifts like rising BP or sleep debt early.
landing.pillar4Desc: An AI that explains patterns and answers questions without diagnosing or prescribing. Strict clinical safety boundaries.
landing.privacySubtitle: Your health data belongs to you. Here is how we guarantee your privacy at every step.
landing.privacy1Desc: Medical reports are read entirely in your browser using local OCR. Files never leave your device.
landing.privacy2Desc: Scores and flags are computed with transparent, auditable algorithms — never black-box AI guesses.
landing.privacy3Desc: Export your complete history as JSON or wipe all local records with a single click anytime from Settings.
landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about getting started with HealthGuardian AI.
landing.faq1Q: What is HealthGuardian AI and how does it help me?
landing.faq1A: HealthGuardian AI is a preventive health companion. It tracks your daily lifestyle habits, explains complex lab reports in simple terms, and spots early health trends before they become chronic problems.
landing.faq2Q: Does HealthGuardian AI replace my doctor?
landing.faq2A: No. HealthGuardian AI supports preventive awareness only and never diagnoses conditions or prescribes medication. It empowers you to understand your body and ask informed questions during doctor appointments.
landing.faq3Q: Can I use my voice to log check-ins?
landing.faq3A: Yes! You can speak naturally in English, Tamil, or Hindi. The conversational engine understands phrases like 'I slept 7 hours and walked for 30 minutes' and fills in your check-in automatically.
landing.faq4Q: Is my medical data kept private?
landing.faq4A: Yes, absolutely. Medical reports are read locally in your browser with zero remote file uploads. Your data is stored in your private account and can be permanently exported or wiped at any time.
landing.mockPillar1Quote: “Slept 7.5 hours, drank 6 glasses of water, 30 min morning walk.”
landing.mockPillar4Msg: “Your fasting glucose is slightly above baseline. Would you like tips on dietary fiber or questions to ask your physician?”

landing.ctaSubtitle: Join HealthGuardian AI. Start with a 60-second voice check-in, test a sample lab report, and protect your long-term wellness.

dataFlow.step4Desc: Explains trends using verified data only

risk.layer1Desc: Deterministic local filter for critical symptoms (chest pain, fainting). Immediately suggests urgent emergency care.
risk.layer2Desc: Evidence-based reference ranges for measured blood pressure and blood glucose to highlight elevated readings.
risk.layer3Desc: Compares recent 3-day habits against your historical median (sleep, hydration, activity). Adapts to your individual normal.

agent.title: Agentic AI: Controlled & Grounded Decision Flow

agent.step2Desc: Agent inspects the returned goal list. If sufficient, it generates the final answer immediately without redundant loops.
agent.writeProtectionDesc: Any action that modifies data (e.g. creating a goal) triggers an explicit user confirmation prompt.

1.title: Welcome to HealthGuardian AI
1.description: Your private, grounded preventive health intelligence platform. HealthGuardian focuses on your personal baseline rather than generic population averages.
1.actionPrompt: Explore your General Health Score and longitudinal habits.
1.keyTakeaway: HealthGuardian never assumes or fabricates missing numbers.

2.title: Profile & Health Background
2.description: Store your health background, known conditions, and emergency contacts securely in your account.
2.actionPrompt: Update your profile preferences and units anytime.
2.keyTakeaway: You maintain total ownership and can export or wipe your data anytime.

3.title: Daily Health Check-in
3.description: Log daily sleep, hydration, exercise, and vitals naturally via typing, voice dictation, or persistent health folder files.
3.actionPrompt: Submit your first check-in to start calculating your personal baseline.
3.keyTakeaway: Explicit zeros are preserved; unmentioned entries stay cleanly missing.

4.title: Health History & Trends
4.description: Inspect your historical records and interactive metric charts over time. Gaps are shown truthfully.
4.actionPrompt: Filter by sleep, water, exercise, weight, or blood pressure.
4.keyTakeaway: Visual trends reveal how your sleep and activity evolve week over week.

5.title: Medical Reports
5.description: Upload lab reports securely. OCR extracts numbers on your device; you review and confirm each value before saving.
5.actionPrompt: Store and track lab tests with client-side OCR verification.
5.keyTakeaway: Raw files remain stored locally in your browser for total privacy.

6.title: Risk & Patterns
6.description: Inspect multi-layered pattern detection. See how your recent 3-day habits deviate from your personal historical median.
6.actionPrompt: Review your General Health Score and lifestyle pattern alerts.
6.keyTakeaway: Patterns reflect personal deviation, not clinical disease diagnoses.

7.title: AI Assistant
7.description: Chat with your safe, grounded health assistant. It dynamically chooses the exact tools needed to answer your questions accurately.
7.actionPrompt: Ask questions like 'How has my sleep changed recently?'
7.keyTakeaway: Answers are strictly grounded in your permitted records with zero hallucination.

8.title: Health Goals
8.description: Set measurable targets for sleep, hydration, and activity. Progress updates automatically whenever you submit daily check-ins.
8.actionPrompt: Create a target like 'Drink 8 glasses of water daily'.
8.keyTakeaway: Track your consistency against realistic personal milestones.

9.title: Notifications Center
9.description: Stay informed with habit reminders and high-confidence adaptive pattern alerts. Sensitive medical details are always kept private.
9.actionPrompt: Review pending reminders and adaptive awareness alerts.
9.keyTakeaway: Notifications support healthy mindfulness, not emergency alarms.

10.title: Specialist Guidance
10.description: Find out which clinical specialties (e.g. Cardiology, Sleep Specialist) may be relevant to discuss recurring patterns with.
10.actionPrompt: Discover suggested physician categories for your doctor visits.
10.keyTakeaway: Guidance is advisory to facilitate informed conversations with your doctor.

11.title: Helpdesk & Support
11.description: Need technical assistance, data help, or feature guidance? Open a support ticket directly from your account.
11.actionPrompt: Reach out for help with application features or data export.
11.keyTakeaway: Application support is for technical inquiries, never medical emergencies.

12.title: Help & Guide Center
12.description: You've completed the tour! You can revisit this Help & Guide center anytime to review data flow diagrams, FAQs, and deep-dive explanations.
12.actionPrompt: Browse interactive learning topics whenever you have questions.
12.keyTakeaway: HealthGuardian is always here to guide you on your wellness journey.

emergency.disclaimer: HealthGuardian is not an emergency response tool. Please call emergency services (112 / 911) or visit the nearest emergency room immediately.
